business_problem: Alltech had accumulated 16 ERP systems across 80 manufacturing sites and 120 countries, which made it difficult to gain supply-chain visibility, standardize data, and make timely business decisions.
solution_summary: Alltech is consolidating 16 legacy ERP systems across 80 manufacturing sites and 120 countries onto Dynamics 365, using the platform as the common operating layer for finance, supply chain, and manufacturing processes. The program combines Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, and Azure Data Lake so product, inventory, and performance data can move from plants and scanners into shared planning, reporting, and control processes. Barcode-based inventory tracking, master planning, freight-selection rules, and common financial dimensions now run in the same environment, while Azure-backed customer portal work extends visibility to customers. Microsoft FastTrack and the AIM Migration Program helped Alltech migrate customized code, execute repeated data migration and testing cycles, and stand up regional cloud installations that give leadership standardized reporting and more responsive supply-chain decisions.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: Standardizes financial management and reporting across Alltech’s business units.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates inventory, planning, freight, and manufacturing-related workflows across plants and regions.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Lake
solution_components.role: Provides the shared data layer for broader analytics and standardized business visibility.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts cloud-based business units and the planned customer portal integrations around Dynamics 365.

data_flow: Plant, inventory, barcode, freight, and financial data flows into Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management, is standardized and planned there, and is extended into Azure Data Lake and Azure-backed portal experiences for reporting and customer visibility.
business_outcome: Alltech reduced inventory on hand, improved reporting speed and manufacturing visibility, and created a scalable foundation for migrating business units and customer-facing services into a common cloud operating model.
